Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to directly access the primary source material (the book content) to extract the specific information required. Instead of successfully retrieving and reading the text from the provided DOI or the linked PDF, the agent immediately resorted to performing additional web searches to find the answer. This reliance on secondary search results rather than direct verification of the source document led to a failure in grounding the final answer in the actual text of the book, resulting in an incorrect conclusion (Jung) instead of the correct one (Kleinpaul). This pattern matches the error signature of over-reliance on external searches and lack of direct source verification.
